data.one_liner: Official LaunchDarkly client-side feature flag SDK for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to connect to LaunchDarkly for feature management, flag evaluation, and event sending. It supports Android, iOS, macOS, Web, Linux, and Windows platforms.
use_when: You use LaunchDarkly for feature management and need to evaluate feature flags in a Flutter application.
You want to perform gradual rollouts or target features based on end-user attributes.
You need to dynamically turn off misbehaving features in production without redeploying.
avoid_when: You do not use LaunchDarkly as your feature flag provider.
You require server-side evaluation patterns rather than client-side SDK features.
strengths: Official SDK supported directly by LaunchDarkly.
Cross-platform support across mobile, desktop, and web.
Centralized testing and consistency across SDK implementations.
weaknesses: Tied exclusively to the LaunchDarkly ecosystem and backend services.
data.setup_notes: Requires providing a LaunchDarkly mobile key during configuration.
